pages.name: revenueRaw
pages.heading: Operations by region | Synthetic revenue
pages.intro: Raw model currency; one GLOBAL sequential color scale. Compare both color and value across the whole loaded grid. Select cells or headers and inspect the native matrix.
pages.footer: Pumps/North is 0; Pumps/West is an explicit BLANK; Filters/East has no fact record. Absence depends on the host matrix representation and completeness. Tooltips include record counts, not a fabricated zero.

pages.name: revenueShares
pages.heading: Row shares | Same numbers, different color scopes
pages.intro: Both visuals assert nonnegative ADDITIVE revenue and divide by the loaded row total. Global colors are comparable; per-row colors are NOT comparable between products. Neither setting changes the model measure.
pages.footer: Without filters, Pumps/Central is 40.0% in BOTH grids. Filter Region to Central: the visible row share becomes 100.0%. The model-authored share in the native matrix remains 40.0%; it removes the Region dimension filter.

pages.name: defectsRaw
pages.heading: Defects by line | Synthetic event counts
pages.intro: Raw defect counts; one GLOBAL sequential color scale. Model sort order is Scratch, Dent, Seal, Label and Line B, Line A, Line C. Colors describe loaded counts, not defect rates.
pages.footer: Scratch/Line B is 0; Dent/Line A is BLANK; Label/Line C has no fact record. Opportunities repeat by defect in the input and MUST NOT be summed over those repeated rows.

pages.name: defectsDenominator
pages.heading: Defects per opportunity | Explicit model denominator
pages.intro: Denominator is the model's Line Inspection Opportunities measure. It removes Defect filters and counts exposure once per line. This is NOT share of visible defects; the additive assertion stays OFF.
pages.footer: Seal/Line B = 4 / 200 = 2.0%. Select only Seal in the Defect slicer: denominator remains 200 for Line B. At multiple-line totals opportunities are 200 + 160 + 100 = 460, not the sum of repeated exposures.

pages.name: interpretation
pages.heading: Interpretation and keyboard | Model versus visible totals
pages.intro: Use Tab to reach the heatmap, then arrows/Home/End to move. Enter/Space selects; Ctrl/Cmd adds selection; Escape clears; Shift+F10 opens the context menu. Verify actual host keyboard and accessibility behavior before release.
pages.footer: Filter Region to Central: Pumps stays 40.0% because its model denominator ignores Region, including RegionSort. Page 02 asks a different question. BLANK is not zero; colors never establish causality. Desktop refresh/open/export remain unverified.
